title: orca-work
description: One Orca agent run on the task that owns it, recorded by the person's press of Record this work in the Temper rail. An append-only log: a task may carry many, from several machines. It says where and when a run happened and how Orca says it ended — never the task's stage, claim or work in flight, which only temper holds. No transcript, terminal output or filesystem path.

agent.description: Orca's agent kind for the run, as Orca names it (claude, codex, opencode, …).

workspace_name.description: The workspace's name as Orca lists it.

branch.description: The workspace's git branch, when Orca lists one (a folder workspace has none).

orca_session_id.description: The agent session Orca names in the launch's terminal: what Orca's agent.resume takes. It belongs to one Orca host.

orca_host.description: The Orca host the run happened on: an opaque digest of the machine, followed by Orca's own host id when the workspace is not local. Reopen is offered only on the host that matches.

started_at.description: When the launch started the run (RFC 3339, UTC).

finished_at.description: When Orca reported the run done (RFC 3339, UTC).

orca_outcome.description: Orca's word for how the run ended. `unreported` when Orca named no outcome. It describes the Orca run, never the task.

session_note.description: The agent's own temper session note for this run, by its bare UUID, when one is known.
